en.html:
I let the stone go and stood up.
Even after I stepped away, Sorimachi stayed on the ground, watching me.

I turned to leave.

Now.
What was I going to do now?

No revenge, I had decided.
What next for Kageaki Minato?

Kageaki"..."
Sorimachi"Going to run? Leave everything you've done lying behind you...?"
